sessionStart.powershell: $novaHookRoot = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { & node (Join-Path $novaHookRoot 'eng/hooks.mjs') --provider copilot --event start }

userPromptSubmitted.powershell: $novaHookRoot = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { & node (Join-Path $novaHookRoot 'eng/hooks.mjs') --provider copilot --event prompt }

agentStop.powershell: $novaHookRoot = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { & node (Join-Path $novaHookRoot 'eng/hooks.mjs') --provider copilot --event stop }
